propositions: A new [code_health] dataclass must be added to _config_schema.py with typed fields: enabled (bool, default False), scan_roots (list[str]), analyzers (dict[str,str] for language-to-tool mapping), size_cap (int|None), and size_near_fraction (float).
The code_health section must support CLI override via `rebar -c code_health.<key>=<val>` using existing override parsing logic.
The code_health section must be re-exported through config.py and integrated into the configuration surface.
The golden surface guard file tests/golden/config_surface.json must be regenerated to include the new [code_health] section and its schema.

Unit tests must verify default loading, CLI override parsing, and missing-section fallback behavior without changing runtime metric behavior or removing hardcoded fallbacks (which are 0734's responsibility).
